paraphrase: Nine finite interpretations over Unit: for the concrete fork, omitting occurrence, the bearer principle, bearer concreteness or bearer existence at the world each leaves the other three true and the world without a concrete existent; an event-route model has an occurring episode that is itself (through an explicit embedding) a concrete entity existing at the world, with an empty bearer relation; for the motion fork, omitting occurrence, the bearer principle, the opining bridge or opinion-as-motion each leaves the other three true and nothing moved.
